title: Paper Balance · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Balance · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead a sheet of paper and a flat table. The lead folds the paper so it balances upright on the table. The folded paper remains upright without support for five seconds. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: One sheet of paper; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Balance, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The folded paper remains upright without support for five seconds.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The folded paper remains upright without support for five seconds.

game.materials: One sheet of paper; a timer
